name: 电商商品上架
description: 从商品资料写出一套上架文案：卖点 → 标题 → 主图和详情页、客服问答（并行）→ 检查。适合淘宝、拼多多、抖店、亚马逊。 / Write a full product listing from your product notes: selling points → titles → main images and detail page, plus customer Q&A (in parallel) → check. For Taobao, Pinduoduo, Douyin shops and Amazon.

product.description: 商品名称，例如：便携榨汁杯 / The product, e.g. a portable blender cup

platform.description: 上架平台：taobao 淘宝/天猫，pinduoduo 拼多多，douyin 抖店，amazon 亚马逊。决定语气和重点 / Where it is sold. Sets tone and emphasis

audience.description: 目标买家 / Who buys it

titleMax.description: 标题长度上限。0 = 按平台常用上限：淘宝、拼多多、抖店 60 个字符（一个汉字算 2 个），亚马逊 75 个字符。平台规则变了就改这里 / Title length limit. 0 uses the platform's usual limit: 60 characters on Taobao, Pinduoduo and Douyin (a Chinese character counts as 2), 75 on Amazon. Change it when the platform's rule changes

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 商品资料
stages.description: 写下商品的真实参数、材质、包装和售后。后面的文案只能用这里的事实。 / Write down the real specs, materials, package contents and after-sales terms. Every later line of copy must come from these facts.

executor.instructions: 把 materials/product.md 换成你的商品资料：参数、材质、包装清单、售后、和同类商品比的优点。示例是虚构的榨汁杯。 / Replace materials/product.md with your product's facts: specs, materials, what is in the box, after-sales terms, and how it beats similar products. The sample is a fictional blender cup.

stages.name: 卖点
stages.description: 用 FABE 法提炼 3 到 6 个卖点：特征 → 优势 → 买家得到的好处 → 证据，再列出买家的顾虑和会搜的词。 / Build 3 to 6 selling points with FABE (feature → advantage → benefit → evidence), plus buyers' worries and search terms.

stages.name: 标题
stages.description: 按「核心词 + 属性词 + 卖点词」写 3 个候选标题，不堆砌、不蹭别的品牌，不超过平台上限。 / Write 3 candidate titles as core term + attributes + selling point, with no stuffing, no borrowed brand names, within the platform limit.

stages.name: 主图和详情页
stages.description: 5 张主图和详情页。按「好处先行」排：首屏好处和场景 → 痛点 → 每屏一个卖点 → 证据和对比 → 参数 → 使用须知 → 包装售后。 / 5 main images and the detail page, benefit first: hero benefit and scene → pain point → one point per screen → evidence and comparison → specs → usage notes → box and after-sales.

stages.name: 客服问答
stages.description: 按 points.json 里买家的顾虑写问答，和详情页并行。不知道的不编。 / Q&A built from the buyer worries in points.json, in parallel with the detail page. Nothing invented.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查标题长度（按平台口径）、重复词、关键词，广告法里的绝对化用语和医疗用语，价格比较用语，以及资料里找不到的数字。 / Check title length (counted the platform's way), repeated words, keywords, absolute and medical terms barred by advertising law, price-comparison wording, and numbers the product facts do not contain.
